source: ShakeFive2; 30 annotated hand reveals in 15 recorded rounds. Identical 640×360 JPEGs for each backend.
method: Only RPS. Offline cached weights via a dedicated loopback server. Two blocks of 30 in mirrored backend order; five unmeasured warm-up requests per block. Worker startup and first request measured separately. Power is the mactop total_power estimate. Joules per decision divide that power by sustained request throughput.
power_method: mactop v2.1.6 total_power estimate. Includes background activity and has no idle subtraction. ANE activity and power component counters emitted zero even during Core AI Neural Engine runs, so component-specific numbers are not interpreted.
